implementation_summary: route.ts: Route gains optional access (AuditAccess) and beta ('allow'|'closed', missing = closed); RouteContext gains params. New resolveRoute returns {route, params}: exact and :param rows (via matchAuditPath, so a bad id or linkId does not match) rank in table order and beat prefix rows; matchRoute delegates to it. New pure authorizeRoute(route, {hasAccessKey, beta, helper?}): no or unknown access -> 403 ERR_ROUTE_CLOSED; owner needs the key (401 ERR_ACCESS_KEY); view/edit/export need the key or helper(permission); sign-in and public are open; in beta only beta 'allow' rows are served, plus sign-in rows and Helper-granted rows (D-004/D-005), else 403 ERR_BETA. index.ts re-exports authorizeRoute, resolveRoute and the new types. plan.ts: all 11 rows are access 'owner', beta 'allow'. server.ts: options routes (test seam, default allRoutes) and helperGrants (default no Helper; a throwing resolver grants nothing); the table is matched before grantAccess; owner rows and unmatched paths keep grantAccess unchanged; matched rows are then authorized (refusals answer JSON {error, code}) and dispatched right after the beta block, before the inline handlers, so no inline handler can answer a path the table opened at a weaker level.
